notes: Verified against catalog. Lower-division 68 units (shared core); upper-division 68 units via ONE depth sequence. Every depth also requires: Technical Electives (units vary by depth), Professional Electives (8 units, two upper-division), and a Design course (4 units: ECE 111, 115, 140B, 190, or 191). Programming is ECE 15 (4 units) for most depths, but ECE 15 AND (17 or 18) = 8 units for Communication Systems, Computer System Design, Machine Learning/Controls, and Signal/Image Processing depths. All depth course lists corroborated on the page.
